en.t: Qwen3.8-27B Turbo on CUDA, one RTX 3090
en.sub: cortiq bench --core: 60 tokens after a prompt of that length, drafts on (the bench text repeats). Release build.
en.res: A real summary of 100 000 characters: first token in 37.6 s, then 80.3 tok/s with drafts past the seal
